title: Tandem Press

services.name: Student Night
services.desc: Tandem Press invites students and the greater Madison community to join us for Student Night on September 17 from 6-9 pm for an evening of live music, printmaking demonstrations, free pizza, and student swag. The event will feature live performances by The Stolen Sea at 6 pm and Mossmen at 8 pm, giving students the opportunity to enjoy music while exploring the press and learning more about printmaking. This event is free and open to the public, with a special invitation to students as they begin their Fall semester. Anyone curious about Tandem Press or printmaking is welcome!
